title: 第3513章 羁绊第3512章 谁都休想离开
content_zh:
当苏尘又一次将神念探入平衡古戒当中，试图唤醒万法至尊仙帝那道残魂的时候……
他的神魂意志，忽然被整个吸入平衡古戒之内！
还不等他反应过来，他的意识，便已经陷入一片混沌当中！
四周白茫茫一片，什么都看不到、听不到、闻不到、感知不到，仿佛所处，乃是一片虚无！
苏尘顿时心中一沉！
现实当中，他和三大真我还在拼命战斗！
倘若自己的神魂意志真的被困在这里，后果简直不堪设想！
一旦他这边战斗落败，对于整个葬天教而言，将会是一场灭顶之灾！
这就是修行世界！
无论是多大的势力，其整体命运，往往都系在一个人的身上！
最多系在几个人的身上！
就好比一个大教，或者一个顶尖大教，或者一个古仙一族……
整个势力绝大部分的实力，其实都集中在一两个人身上！
一旦那一两个人遭劫……
便是整个势力遭劫！
强大如那些古仙一族，一旦他们的仙帝陨落……
那么他们整个一族，也将很快陷入毁灭，成为其他古仙一族眼中的肥肉！
如今的葬天教亦是如此！
如今整个葬天教的实力，主要集中在苏尘、荒、大衍梵天仙帝身上！
最多再加上苏毅苏珂苏无敌三人！

现如今，荒和大衍梵天仙帝被敌人调虎离山，只剩下苏尘！
一旦苏尘这边落败，只凭苏毅苏珂苏无敌三人，根本抵挡不住光耀仙帝的攻势！
“该死，这究竟是怎么回事？”
苏尘顿时有些心急，尝试着施展各种手段。
但是最终，他却惊恐发现，在这里，他所有的神通仙法，统统失效，根本无法施展出来。
并且……
他逐渐发现，无论自己多么着急也没有用。
这里仿佛与外界彻底隔绝，根本无法感知到现实当中的一切。
甚至就连时光、空间，都感知不到。
意识到这一点，苏尘反而逐渐的冷静下来。
开始集中精神，仔细感知这片空间。
渐渐的……
他发现他的神识、念头、感知，开始变得空灵起来！
不知过了多久，他竟是隐隐约约，仿佛察觉到了什么！
但是当他用力去感知的时候，周围再次恢复一片混沌！
“咦？这是怎么回事？”
苏尘心中闪过一丝疑虑。
于是。
他彻底放开心灵，不再去想其它，让自己的感知，化作自由飞翔的蝴蝶，彻底变得空灵……
不知过了多久。

因为他现在完全无法感知到时光的存在。
或许是过去了一万年！
又或许是一瞬之间！
content_en:
When Su Chen once again put his spiritual thoughts into the Ancient Ring of Balance, trying to awaken the remnant soul of the Supreme Immortal Emperor of All Laws...
His soul and will were suddenly sucked into the Ancient Ring of Balance!
Before he could react, his consciousness had fallen into chaos!
The surroundings were completely white, nothing could be seen, heard, smelled, or felt. It was as if the place we were in was nothingness!
Su Chen's heart suddenly sank!
In reality, he and the three true selves are still fighting desperately!
If his soul and will were really trapped here, the consequences would be unimaginable!
Once his side loses the battle, it will be a disaster for the entire Tian Burial Sect!
This is the world of spiritual practice!
No matter how big a force it is, its overall destiny is often tied to one person!
It can be tied to a few people at most!
Just like a great sect, or a top sect, or a clan of ancient immortals...
Most of the strength of the entire force is actually concentrated in one or two people!
Once those one or two people are robbed...
The entire force was robbed!
As powerful as those ancient immortal clans, once their immortal emperor falls...
Then their entire clan will soon fall into destruction and become fat in the eyes of other ancient immortal clans!
The same is true for today’s Burying Heaven Sect!
Nowadays, the strength of the entire Tian Burial Sect is mainly concentrated on Su Chen, Huang, and Dayan Brahma Heaven Immortal Emperor!
At most, there are three more people including Su Yi, Su Ke, and Su Wudi!
Now, Huang and Dayan Brahma Immortal Emperor have been driven away by their enemies, leaving only Su Chen!
Once Su Chen's side is defeated, Su Yi, Su Ke and Su Wudi alone will not be able to withstand the offensive of Emperor Guangyao!
"Damn, what the hell is going on?"
Su Chen suddenly became anxious and tried various methods.
But in the end, he was horrified to find that all his magical powers and magic were ineffective here and could not be used at all.
And...
He gradually realized that no matter how anxious he was, it was of no use.
This place seems to be completely isolated from the outside world, and it is impossible to perceive anything in reality.
Even time and space cannot be sensed.
Realizing this, Su Chen gradually calmed down.
Begin to concentrate and carefully perceive this space.
Gradually...
He found that his consciousness, thoughts, and perceptions began to become ethereal!
I don't know how long it took, but he vaguely seemed to notice something!
But when he tried to sense it, the surroundings returned to chaos again!
"Huh? What's going on?"
Su Chen had a flash of doubt in his heart.
then.
He completely let go of his mind, stopped thinking about other things, and allowed his perception to turn into a freely flying butterfly, completely becoming ethereal...
I don’t know how much time passed.
Because he is completely unable to perceive the existence of time now.
Maybe ten thousand years have passed!
Or maybe in an instant!
